tasks.title: Refresh AI Factory backlog
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current state of mission.md, AGENTS.md, recent PRs, and merged work.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve task_queue.json by ensuring all roles have focused tasks, avoiding duplication, and updating write/avoid scopes.
[CONSTRAINTS] Use 4-part RECURSIVE META-PROMPTING PROTOCOL for prompts. Do not change application code.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] task_queue.json is updated, properly formatted, and all new prompts follow the protocol.

tasks.title: Improve backend API behavior
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current backend API endpoints for agents, sessions, models, skills, or settings.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Implement one focused backend API improvement, adding tests if practical.
[CONSTRAINTS] Keep the diff small. Write async, type-hinted code. Touch only backend/ and tests/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] One API endpoint is improved, behavior is stable, and tests pass.

tasks.title: Improve runtime configuration handling
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current configuration handling in backend/config.py and .env.example.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve runtime configuration ergonomics, moving towards environment variables.
[CONSTRAINTS] Keep secrets out of the repository. Prefer deterministic tests. Touch only backend/config.py, backend/, tests/, and .env.example.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Config handling is more robust, relying on env vars, and tests verify configuration parsing.

tasks.title: Expand websocket test coverage
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current test coverage for backend/websocket/.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Add or improve test coverage for websocket connection management and message handling.
[CONSTRAINTS] Avoid real network calls. Touch only tests/ and backend/websocket/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] New tests verify websocket behavior deterministically without external dependencies.

tasks.title: Refactor a small backend area
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current backend codebase.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Refactor one small backend area to improve readability or reduce duplication.
[CONSTRAINTS] Preserve existing behavior. Add or update tests when practical. Touch only backend/ and tests/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Code is refactored for better readability/maintainability, and all tests pass.

tasks.title: Document setup and operations
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current README.md, docs/, AGENTS.md, and mission.md.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve setup documentation for local development, secrets, GitHub Actions, and validation.
[CONSTRAINTS] Do not change application code. Touch only docs-related files.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Setup instructions are clearer, more comprehensive, and accurate based on current repository state.

tasks.title: Improve frontend feedback mechanisms
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current frontend UI feedback in modals (loading states and error displays).
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Improve error handling by displaying contextual error messages returned from the API, rather than generic strings.
[CONSTRAINTS] Preserve visual layout. Touch only frontend/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Error messages from API are parsed and displayed gracefully in the frontend modals.

tasks.title: Document API payload examples
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current API documentation in docs/API_NOTES.md.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Expand documentation to include clear JSON payload examples for creating agents, sessions, and skills.
[CONSTRAINTS] Do not change application code. Touch only docs/ and README.md.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] docs/API_NOTES.md includes accurate request and response payload examples based on the current implementation.

tasks.title: Harden secret validation logic
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current runtime secret parsing logic in backend/config.py.
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Add stricter validation logic to ensure API keys are not accidentally logged or included in basic configuration dumps.
[CONSTRAINTS] Prefer environment variables and placeholders. Do not commit real credentials. Touch only backend/config.py and tests.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] config.py strictly validates API keys and explicitly filters them from being stringified, with unit tests confirming behavior.

tasks.title: Refactor frontend JS components
tasks.prompt:
[INPUT STATE] Current JS in frontend/ (e.g., app.js, agents.js).
[ATOMIC OBJECTIVE] Extract further common utility functions (like API fetching wrappers or common DOM manipulations) into frontend/js/ui.js.
[CONSTRAINTS] Preserve existing behavior and visual layout. Touch only frontend/.
[ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA] Duplicated API or DOM logic is centralized in ui.js, and app continues to function correctly.
